meta.defaultTitle: ODIN — Farm & Resort Experience near Pattaya
meta.description: Ride, explore, relax and eat at ODIN, a countryside farm and resort experience about 20 km from Pattaya, Thailand.

home.heroTitle: ODIN — Farm & Resort Experience near Pattaya
home.heroSubtitle: A countryside farm and resort morning, afternoon, and evening — horses, open trails, a wood-fired sauna, and a table waiting at the end of it.
home.heroNote: This is a request to book — our team confirms availability with you directly.
home.experiencesIntro: Four ways to spend your day at ODIN, each with its own pace.

horseRiding.title: Horse Riding
horseRiding.shortDescription: A guided ride through the farm's open countryside.

ponyRiding.title: Pony Riding
ponyRiding.shortDescription: A gentle, family-friendly ride for younger riders.

atv.title: ATV
atv.shortDescription: Off-road exploring across the farm's trails.

sauna.title: Sauna
sauna.shortDescription: Wind down after a day of riding and exploring.

whyOdin.heading: A working farm, not a theme park
whyOdin.lead: ODIN pairs open countryside with a slower pace — ride and explore by day, unwind by evening, and finish at a table that's part of the same place, not a separate attraction bolted on beside it.
whyOdin.distanceNote: {distance} from Pattaya — close enough for a day trip, far enough to feel like the countryside.

pillarRide.title: Ride & Explore
pillarRide.description: Horses, ponies, and ATV trails across the farm's open ground.

pillarRest.title: Slow Down
pillarRest.description: A wood-fired sauna to unwind after a day outdoors.

pillarTable.title: A Table Waiting
pillarTable.description: Farm-to-table dining to close out the day.

whyOdin.experienceCount: {count} signature experiences, each bookable on its own or as part of a package.

reviews.heading: Guest Stories
reviews.comingSoonBody: ODIN is just getting started welcoming guests — real stories from the people who visit will appear here once they're in.

location.heading: Location
location.body: ODIN is set in the countryside {distance} from Pattaya. Directions and a map link will be available closer to launch.

howToBook.question: How do I book an experience?
howToBook.answer: Submit a booking request through our booking form. Our team confirms availability with you directly — a request isn't an automatic reservation.

whatToBring.question: What should I bring?
whatToBring.answer: Comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes are recommended. Anything specific to an experience is listed on its page.

gettingThere.question: How do I get to ODIN?
gettingThere.answer: ODIN is located approximately {distance} from Pattaya. See the Location page for directions and a map link.

finalCta.heading: Ready to plan your day at ODIN?
finalCta.body: Send a request and our team will confirm availability with you directly.
